Results.ReviewText: I bought a Weber grill in 1990. It worked flawlessly and finally died in 2020. In that 30 years I had to replace the Flavorizer bars because they rusted. Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Our old grill burst into flames while my back was turned from our sliding glass door to watch TV. A few minutes later, my wife alerted me to the fire and prevented me from becoming an old "Six Feet Under" episode-opener. Anyhow . . . reviews led us to this grill and - so far - it's a delight. The push-button starter gently ignites. The flames are hidden beneath a metal guard. With the lid-thermometer I can gauge the heat perfectly. I am doing a lot more barbecuing now, as my wife has always wanted me to do. I love it. I have two caveats. 1. Don't follow the guidelines for how long to cook particular foods that are included in the instructions. 2. I've only had it a couple of weeks and used it 3 or 4 times. I most product reviews come out too soon, based on a very short time of use. That's why I titled this, "So far, . . ."
Results.Title: So far, great!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
